# Frontend design guardrails — distinctive, non-generic UI with hard rules

Curated by Skill Harbor — @customware-ai's frontend-design skill: a rule-driven methodology for distinctive interfaces, with hard guardrails rather than vague inspiration. Enforces typography discipline (a small set of deliberate type choices), color discipline (restrained palettes with intent), hard constraints against the generic AI look (no default gradients, no cookie-cutter hero sections, no stock-icon mush), component consistency checks, spacing and layout rules, and a design-review checklist to run before shipping. Honest caveats: several frontend-design fiches already exist in the catalog — this one is kept for its strict, checkable rule format; compare with the existing ones and install the one whose style of guidance fits you best. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
